content.text: That sounds brutal, I'm sorry. Two hours of screaming at 28 months is a rough stretch, and it's common at this age. Tonight, try going in calm and low-key: a hand on his back, a few quiet words, lights off, no big conversation, no picking him up unless he really needs it. If he's screaming but doesn't seem fully awake, he may not be able to take comfort at all, and staying close until it passes is the whole job. If it's frequent, or anything about it worries you, mention it to his provider.
